headline: Post-open Nasdaq path remains two-sided after stronger U.S. data
body: Empire State manufacturing rose to 20.6 and the NAHB housing-market index rose to 35, both above consensus. Nasdaq was near flat in Reuters’ 09:40 ET update after a modestly positive open, while Nasdaq breadth was negative and memory-chip names were strong. The observed path is therefore event-driven and two-sided rather than a verified persistent no-retracement trend.
